data.one_liner: Animated button with loading, success and error states for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a button widget that shows a loading spinner when pressed and can transition to success or error animations. A controller lets you trigger success, error, or reset programmatically.
use_when: You need a quick loading indicator on a button press
You want built‑in success/error feedback without writing custom animations
avoid_when: You require extensive visual customization beyond the provided options
You prefer to avoid extra dependencies like rxdart
weaknesses: Limited styling beyond preset colors and icons
